sloka: ततो विभिन्नसर्वाङ्गौ शरशल्याचितावुभौ ।ध्वजाविव महेन्द्रस्य रज्जुमुक्तौ प्रकम्पितौ ।। ६.४५.१७ ।।।।
transliteration: tato vibhinnasarvāṅgau śaraśalyācitāvubhau ।dhvajāviva mahendrasya rajjumuktau prakampitau ।। 6.45.17 ।।।।

translations.english: Pierced all over their bodies with the heads of arrows, the gallant princes freed themselves from the cords by shaking violently like the banners of Indra. Pained by the hurting of the vital parts of both the princes, the Lords of the world fell.
translations.hindi: आर समस्त जीवों की दुस्तर कालरात्रि की तरह बह जान ` पड़ती थी । वहाँ पर समस्त राक्षस उस दारुण अंधकार में
